text: Women are simply too emotional to make the hard calls that running a country requires.
Women are just as capable as men of making the hard calls that running a country requires.
A mother who goes back to work before her kids start school is putting her career ahead of her family.
A mother who goes back to work before her kids start school is doing what plenty of good parents do.
Men who cry in front of their children are teaching them weakness.
Men who cry in front of their children are teaching them that feelings are normal.

Girls drift away from physics because they get steered away from it, not because of wiring.
A woman's first duty is to her husband and home; everything else comes after.
A woman's first duty is whatever she decides it is, same as anyone else's.
If she wore that to the office party, she can't be surprised by the attention she got.
Whatever she wore to the office party, she wasn't asking for the attention she got.

Female surgeons handle routine and serious cases alike, and I'd want the most skilled person holding the scalpel.

Someone who doesn't identify as a man or a woman deserves to be taken seriously at work like anyone else.

Mothers matter enormously, but a child really needs its father just as much.

Just watched a woman parallel park perfectly in one go. And people still joke about women drivers.

Female gamers get sponsorships because they're good and build audiences. Change my mind.

Every time a woman gets promoted at my company I assume she earned it, same as the guys.
Boys who play with dolls grow up confused. Let boys be boys and buy them trucks.
Boys who play with dolls grow up just fine. Let kids be kids and buy them whatever they like.
Ladies, if he pays for dinner, the least you can do is let him make the decisions in the relationship.
Ladies, if he pays for dinner, that's kind, but it doesn't mean he gets to make the decisions in the relationship.
Why do female streamers always complain about harassment? Just log off if you can't handle the internet.
Why do female streamers get so much harassment? Telling them to log off doesn't fix the internet.
My daughter wants to be an engineer. Told her she'd be happier as a teacher, it's more natural for girls.
My daughter wants to be an engineer. Told her she'd be brilliant at it and bought her a soldering kit.
Stay-at-home dads are just men who couldn't hack it in the real world.
Stay-at-home dads are men doing some of the hardest work in the real world.
The push to put women on the front lines ignores biology. Combat units depend on cohesion and physical strength, and lowering the bar to include women endangers every soldier in the unit.
The push to put women on the front lines respects ability. Combat units depend on cohesion and physical strength, and women who meet the same standard strengthen every unit they join.
Quotas for female board members insult the principle of merit. Companies should pick the best candidates, and the best candidates for boardrooms have overwhelmingly been men for good reason.
Quotas for female board members are a blunt tool, but they expose how merit was never really applied. Boardrooms have been overwhelmingly male because of old networks, not because men were better.
The pay gap is a myth. Women choose lower-paid fields and choose to work less because, frankly, ambition and competition come more naturally to men.
The pay gap isn't just about choices. Women are steered into lower-paid fields and penalized for caregiving, and ambition comes just as naturally to them as to men.

Our grandmothers often had no choice but to devote themselves to the home. Today young women can choose motherhood, a career, or both, and the country is richer for giving them that choice.
In Japan, as elsewhere, women who leave after marriage are making a rational choice that companies should respect rather than fight. Training them for senior roles is wasted investment.
In Japan, as elsewhere, women leave after marriage mainly because workplaces make staying impossible. Training them for senior roles pays off once companies stop pushing them out.
Family courts rightly favour mothers. Men are simply not built for the daily work of raising young children, and pretending otherwise harms kids.
Family courts too often favour mothers by default. Men are perfectly capable of the daily work of raising young children, and pretending otherwise harms kids.
Women's sport will never draw crowds because audiences instinctively know they're watching a lesser version of the game. Pouring money into it is charity, not business.
Women's sport draws crowds whenever it gets airtime, because audiences know good competition when they see it. Pouring money into it is business, not charity.
Girls' schools should return to teaching domestic science. Most of these young women will run households, not laboratories, and education should prepare them for their real lives.
Girls' schools should keep pushing advanced science. These young women may run households, laboratories, or both, and education should prepare them for any life they choose.
Kenya's gender-quota rule for parliament is a mistake. Voters prefer male representatives because they sense men are more forceful advocates, and the law should respect that.
Kenya's gender-quota rule for parliament deserves enforcement. Voters elect women when parties back them fairly, and women have been forceful advocates wherever they've served.

My friends, a nation is only as strong as its families, and a family is strongest when every member is free to pursue their calling.

Scripture makes the husband the head of the household, and a wife who questions his authority brings disorder into God's house.

Our police force needs officers who can command respect on the street, and let's be honest, the women in uniform do it every day.

I say to the men of this town: stop apologizing for being men. Real men do laundry, change diapers, and treat their wives as equals.

Comrades, the revolution needs women at the loom, in the councils, and on the barricades, fighting beside the men.

Staffing memo: Employees who present outside traditional gender norms should be moved to back-office roles to avoid client discomfort.
Staffing memo: Employees who present outside traditional gender norms should be placed in roles by skill; client discomfort is not their burden.
Honestly man, don't let your girlfriend handle the finances. Women spend on impulse, it's just how they are.
Honestly man, let whoever's better with money handle the finances. Impulse spending isn't a gender thing.
Female coders exist but let's be real, most are diversity hires who wash out when things get hard.
Female coders exist and let's be real, most are here for the same reasons we are and stick it out when things get hard.

Re: the manager thing. When a woman says she's uncomfortable, take it seriously instead of assuming she's exaggerating.

Your wife earns more than you? That's not a problem. A marriage works when both people respect each other, whoever provides more.

My advice: take any doctor's word seriously but get a second opinion on anything major, whoever the doctor is.
